description: Boston Buildings Inventory is a dataset listed in City of Boston open data portal (Analyze Boston), an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment Department. This dataset pulls from many different data sources to identify individual building characteristics of all buildings in Boston. It also identifies high-potential retrofit options to reduce carbon emissions in multifamily buildings, using the best available data and assumptions from building experts. Building characteristics will require on-site verification before an owner can act on them. Coverage: Boston, Massachusetts. The portal files it under the publisher Environment Department. Its tags are building inventory, carbon emissions, environment, retrofit, sustainability. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2020-05-11 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License (PDDL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-boston-portal.
